description: Find C functions, macros, types and variables by name in the indexed source (HEAD): BM25 on names, then fuzzy and body matches. Filter by kind (function, struct, macro, ...), language, repository. Each result: qualified_name, name, kind, language, file, start_line and end_line. Like `ctags`/`git grep -w` for definitions. Follow with get_callers, or git_show_file with start_line/end_line to read the body.

kind.description: Filter by symbol kind: function, class, method, struct, enum, interface, trait, etc.

language.description: Filter by language: go, python, c, cpp, rust, java, typescript, javascript, etc.

query.description: Search query (symbol name, partial name, or keyword)

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

name: search_symbols
